title: The Landing Says What the Tool Is For, and Shows It Working
description: หน้าแรกเดิมบอกว่า "แอปงานโยธา ใช้งานง่าย" แล้วให้เลือกแอปทันที โดยไม่เคยบอกว่าปัญหาที่เครื่องมือนี้แก้คืออะไร และภาพแผนผังฝั่งขวาเป็นภาพนิ่งที่ไม่สื่อว่าเครื่องมือนี้ทำงานเป็นลำดับ รอบนี้เพิ่มสองอย่าง: ลำดับ 01-04 ที่เดินให้เห็นพร้อมเส้นสำรวจที่อ่านแผนผังไปเรื่อย ๆ และหัวข้อปัญหาสามข้อที่มาจากงานประมาณราคาจริง ไม่ใช่ข้อความการตลาด
scope: draw the hero blueprint on load in the order a drawing is drawn, then keep a survey sweep and its dimension tick reading across it
walk the start rail from 01 to 04 so the sequence the product is built around is visible before a word is read, and pause it the moment a pointer or keyboard focus lands on a step
state the three failures a defensible estimate has to answer for, each paired with what the product does about it
keep the pricing claim honest: the third card says the costing layer is still in development rather than implying it exists
hold every new motion inside the existing reduced-motion contract so a reader who asks for stillness gets a complete, static drawing
verification: screenshots at two points in the same animation show the rail on step 01 and later on step 04, and the sweep tick at two different positions on the deck
a run with prefers-reduced-motion forced shows the complete drawing with no highlight, no sweep and no partial strokes
measured through the DevTools protocol at 1440 and at 390 with mobile emulation, documentElement.scrollWidth equals innerWidth, so neither viewport scrolls sideways
the same measurement confirms all four rail steps and the sweep carry a running animation name rather than only being styled for it
pnpm typecheck, pnpm lint and pnpm test pass
rollback: Revert the v0.21.0 commit. The change is three presentation files: the hero art component, the landing page and the stylesheet. No schema, no server behaviour and no product claim outside the landing copy.
constraints: The problem statements are drawn from docs/research/kusumal-hospital-real-project-gap-2026-08-23.md and from the audit, not invented for the page.
No layout, wording or asset is taken from any competitor page; the three-card shape is a common one and the content is this project's own.
Motion must not compete with the primary action: a step under the pointer or keyboard focus stops animating.
The landing may not describe the costing layer as available while estimation-workspace.tsx still simulates price approval in client state.

items.title: Make the landing hero move the way the tool works, and name the problem it solves
Obtain the Factor F table at the announced 6% loan interest rate, with the circular that announces it
Seed the Factor F table as a versioned dataset carrying its interest rate, effective dates, source checksum and reviewer
Record ประมาณราคาเมื่อวันที่ and ประมาณราคาโดย on the estimate so the sheet header can be filled
Retire takeoff_items.category once headings carry the same meaning
Give price observations a unit, a material and labour split, and a condition, because the official labour schedule prices one item at several rates
Require a human verification step before any OCR-extracted price or factor can be used in a calculation
Enforce capabilities.read on every ESTIMETR read path so the platform kill switch stops reads, not only writes
Order organization selection deterministically before a member can belong to more than one organization
Validate the official source for ปร.4, ปร.5 and ปร.6 against the Comptroller General's Department, which ว499 and ว481 confirm is the issuing authority
Apply GitHub branch protection once the plan upgrade allows it
Give roadmap item ids a single owner: IP-059 was issued twice, in v0.18.0 and again in v0.20.0, for unrelated work
